claims.nodeLabel: Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP / AAITP)
claims.text: The DIA release consistently spells it 'AAITP' (Advanced Aerospace Threat and Identification Program) in 2009 documents, not the later-familiar 'AATIP'. The USD(I) memorandum subject line reads: 'Senator Harry Reid's Request to Put the Advanced Aerospace Threat and Identification Program (AAITP) under Special Access Protection'.

claims.nodeLabel: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
claims.text: Same USD(I) memo: 'The resulting contract was for multiple sub-contractors to perform unclassified research in 11 technical areas and deliver technical reports on those areas by July 31 2009.'

claims.nodeLabel: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
claims.text: USD(I) memorandum to the Deputy Secretary of Defense states plainly: 'The AAITP that SEN Reid refers to is officially the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Application Program (AAWSAP) contract managed by DIA. Its primary purpose is to investigate revolutionary advances in future aerospace technologies with emphasis on research of unconventional and revolutionary technologies. The sole bid for the contract was from Bigelow Aerospace Advance Space Studies located in Las Vegas, NV.'
USD(I) memorandum to DEPSECDEF: 'The sole bid for the contract was from Bigelow Aerospace Advance Space Studies located in Las Vegas, NV.'

claims.nodeLabel: Reid Letter to DEPSECDEF Requesting Restricted SAP Status
claims.text: The USD(I) memorandum to DEPSECDEF confirms receipt and framing: 'Senator Harry Reid sent a letter to you on June 24, 2009 requesting the Department of Defense put the AAITP under "Restricted Special Access Protection" (Tab A).'

b.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.note: He is the reason the money existed. DIA records Reid as co-sponsor with Senator Daniel Inouye of the language in the July 2008 Supplemental Appropriation directing DIA to investigate far-term foreign advanced aerospace threats, which is the appropriation AAWSAP was run on.

b.label: Reid Letter to DEPSECDEF Requesting Restricted SAP Status

edges.note: He signed it. The letter of 24 June 2009 to Deputy Secretary William J. Lynn III went on Senate Majority Leader letterhead - 'HARRY REID, MAJORITY LEADER, NEVADA' - and asked the Department to place the programme under a restricted special access programme.
